concept.title: Booking and limited places
concept.shortdesc: Conditions about how places are given out, such as limited capacity on a first come first served basis or by appointment only.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Capacity limits on a session or class, with places given out on a first come, first served basis.
: Services available only by making an appointment, including appointment-based applications and clinics.
: Needing to book a place or session before attending.
